messages:
jess: tiny design sync: auto-fallback controls 11 p95 + error% or single slider?
ryan: separate controls. clarity beats simplicity for SREs.
priya: separate + presets (conservative / normal / aggressive). advanced hidden.
jess: defaults idea for hosted: p95=400ms, error=0.8%. per-route presets for embeddings/chat.
ryan: must show which events count (5xx, timeout, model_reject). otherwise users will be confused.
priya: preview panel: estimated switch % from sampled last-72h telemetry (default sample_pct=5%). show matched/total.
ops-bot: warning: full-window scans heavy. recommend sampling windows and cap queries.
taylor: audit defaults: canary=12%, auto-fallback=1%, capture_payload off by default. show privacy/cost badge.
ryan: oscillation protection: debounce_ms + min_switch_interval + exponential backoff. UI should expose those.
jess: operator override flow: require reason + optional TTL, record audit event, show undo for 5m.
priya: rule builder: boolean expression UI (status==500 OR contains(msg,"OOM") OR latency>1000) with live sample matches and templates.
ops-bot: security: sandbox expressions, limit regex complexity, audit playback access.
jess: i'll mock the console: two inputs + preset dropdown, advanced rule builder, preview sim, hysteresis controls, audit toggles and timeline. posting tomorrow AM.
ryan: i'll add playback API stub and migration notes.
priya: adding runbook checklist items.
ops-bot: prototype review scheduled tomorrow 10:30am PT.
